card.name: Linking words in lists before duration
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, of, commas, the) inside a list of factors like dose, route or type, right before the next factor such as duration, frequency, rate or interval.

modes.label: And/comma after dose
modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma follows 'dose' in a list of factors that an effect depends on.
modes.example: Recovery time for normal HPA activity is variable depending upon the dose<< and>> duration of treatment.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: 'of' or 'the' in a list of features, before a property like volume or cause.
modes.example: the location of the discomfort, the type of pain and<< the>> cause of pain.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for measurable properties like frequency, duration, location and thickness.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after 'dose' or similar, when the next word is likely 'duration' or 'frequency'.
